result.instructions: Tools for Typless, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Extract the supplier, dates and line items from this invoice PDF."; "Which of our document extractions finished since yesterday?"; "What is the status of extraction 0d14338251a6db69bfec36face27f7edcab7322?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Typless data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run typless_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run typless_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run typless_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. typless_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: typless_list_awaiting_poll
tools.title: List finished extractions
tools.description: List extraction ids that finished in the last 2 days and were not polled yet. Use typless_get_extraction with each id to read the result. Typless API: GET /api/v1/awaiting-poll.

customer.description: Your internal customer id. Typless uses it for usage reports and to filter the poll queue.

tools.name: typless_get_extraction
tools.title: Get an extraction result
tools.description: Get the status and result of one extraction by extraction_id. status is IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, ERROR or EXPIRED; result is empty until the status is SUCCESS. Calling it also removes the id from typless_list_awaiting_poll. The result is deleted 48 hours after processing finishes. Typless API: GET /api/v2/get-extraction-data.

extraction_id.description: The extraction id from typless_extract_data_async or typless_list_awaiting_poll.

ocr_data.description: Also return OCR text blocks, adjusted file URL and Markdown content, when the document type produces them.

tools.name: typless_extract_data
tools.title: Extract data from a document
tools.description: Extract fields from one document and wait for the result in the same call. Send the file as base64. Accepts PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF and BMP up to 10 MB; use typless_extract_data_async for larger files. The document type must exist in the customer's Typless account. Typless API: POST /api/v1/extract-data.

document_type_name.description: Name of the document type to extract with, for example line-item-invoice.

file_name.description: Original file name with its extension, for example invoice.pdf. The extension must match the file content.

file_base64.description: The file content as a base64 string (up to 10 MB before encoding).

customer.description: Your internal customer id. Typless uses it for usage reports and to filter the poll queue.

tools.name: typless_extract_data_async
tools.title: Start an extraction
tools.description: Start an extraction and return an extraction_id at once (HTTP 202). Send the file as base64 (file_base64) or as a public https URL (file_url), not both. file_url files can be up to 35 MiB and must download within 60 seconds. Read the result later with typless_get_extraction. Typless API: POST /api/v1/extract-data-async.

document_type_name.description: Name of the document type to extract with, for example line-item-invoice.

file_name.description: Original file name with its extension, for example invoice.pdf. The extension must match the file content.

file_base64.description: The file content as a base64 string. Pass this or file_url.

file_url.description: Public https URL of the file (redirects are not followed). Pass this or file_base64.

customer.description: Your internal customer id. Typless uses it for usage reports and to filter the poll queue.
